name: Miro
verdict_reason: Excalidraw covers the sketching that most Miro seats actually do, in one tiny container. Worth it if solo or link-sharing files; live multi-cursor rooms need the extra room server and that's where the weekend goes.
what_you_lose: Persistent boards with access control — vanilla Excalidraw saves .excalidraw files, not a board library

what_broke: None for the drawing app; know that collab rooms are a second project (excalidraw-room + storage)
